segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-leaning skin report a glowy, smooth look and quick absorption, with one noting a minor breakout risk if she skips it for a day or two.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin are split: one with acne-prone reactive skin broke out badly and warns against it, while one with oily sensitive skin says it stopped the breakouts she got from the original toner and became a holy grail.

concerns.spots: Reports diverge sharply: one reviewer broke out with pimples all over her face and closed comedones and warns against it for acne-prone or reactive skin, while another says it worked well on her teen's acne-prone skin and a third had no breakouts and switched to this version specifically to stop breakouts caused by the original toner.
concerns.blemishes: Same divide as spots: one user got closed comedones and facial breakouts, another reports six months with no breakouts after switching from the original, and a teen user's acne-prone skin is described as doing great with it.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe it as hydrating despite a light, watery feel, citing improved softness, balance, and less dryness on tired or dry days; one says she can skip moisturizer in the morning because it absorbs so well.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a damaged barrier (from another product) experienced light irritation and paused use, then resumed once her barrier recovered.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers describe the product as light, quickly absorbed, and non-greasy, giving a glowy or dewy finish rather than a heavy one.

extraits.texte: I was so exicted to try this toner becaue i loveee milky toners but this sadly broke me out with pimples all over my face and closed comedones. It asvises it is safe for sensitive skin but if you have acne or reactive slin i would avoid this

I was using the original one but unfortunately after giving it a few weeks it continuously made me break out. I have oily sensitive skin and I decided to try the light weight version and i love it. Have not had a break out since switchingand its been a good 6 months. Its a part if my holy grail items. Feels like water but leaves a nice dew on skin. I use before my serum and moisturizer. It help my skin to absorb my other products evenly and quickly. Highly recommend

Has great hydration thats feels light on the skin, i sometimes go without moisturizing in the morning because it absorbs well. Heavy glass bortle feels spensive✨ but I definitely fear the day i accidentally knock it over, considering on puting it in a mister bottle for to go use. Will be keeping it in the regimen till i can find something better but i expect if to be awhile! I did experience light irritation when my barrier was a damged from another product so i had to stop briefly but its back in and doing its job. My skin leans towards slighlty oily most days and oily oily occasionally, just enough to keep my skin hydrated but also enough for a minor break out if i slack off 1-2 days of the week. Was recommended "light" over the other one for acne probe/oily skin 👍🏼

extraits.titre: Great for my teens acne skin!
extraits.texte: Looking for simething in between a harsh toner and milky toner? This is it! Got this for my 15yr old. Been working out great on her acne prone skin.

I didn't expect to like this toner as much as I do. The texture is slightly milky but still very light, and it absorbs into the skin really quickly. After using it for a while, my skin feels more hydrated and balanced, especially on days when it feels dry or tired.

I got a small bottle of this to try after I got the larger bottle of original toner. This feels like water was just added to the original. It isn't creamy or anything and doesn't feel smooth on the skin. It makes your skin feel like chalk or sand paper (i guess you could say it feels matte). Not impressed, winter is coming so I'll have a reason to use the original but this is probably going to be given to a sister that wants to try it.
I have oily skin and have been loving this product. Makes skin look glowy and smooth.

reserve: With only 10 reviews and just a few mentioning skin type explicitly, the segment-level conclusions are based on a very small sample.
